name: BUD
description: BUD (Bots Up Display) lets you talk to your Grok Bots from your G2: pick a bot, speak a task, and it is sent. Replies arrive as Grok Bot notifications. Set up your bots' webhook URLs, sender keys and your xAI API key on the phone page; they stay on your phone. Approvals stay in the Grok Bot app.
author: cmdlabtech

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Sends your recorded voice to xAI to turn it into text, and sends the text to the bot you picked through its Grok Bot webhook.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Records a short voice message while you hold or tap to talk. The audio goes to xAI with your own API key to be turned into text.
